item.text: The package implementation is in place with a mutex-protected ordered backlog, per-cursor positions, a close-and-replace notification channel, and grace expiration for cursors whose unread backlog exceeds capacity. Next I’m formatting it and checking the project’s Go version/dependency details before running focused tests.

Implemented the `fanoutbuffer` package in [buffer.go](/app/fanoutbuffer/buffer.go) with configurable defaults, concurrent cursors, blocking and nonblocking reads, close notifications, backlog cleanup, and grace-period errors.

`go test ./fanoutbuffer` passed; the package currently has no existing tests.
